llm_runtime.choice: @wllama/wllama@3.13.0 (npm, Apache-2.0; llama.cpp WASM, libllama b12211-7d7f028) — selected by real-browser measurement (model_selection.md): transformers.js 4.3.2 measured no cleanup completion within 450 s at 350 max tokens (vs 64-92 s on wllama for the same prompt class) and would add a second ~570 MB CI download; WebLLM is WebGPU-only (navigator.gpu absent in Playwright WebKit, and plan D8 keeps the WebGPU path NOT_RUN on this host)
llm_runtime.wasm_asset: @wllama/wllama/esm/wasm/wllama.wasm — 10,244,628 bytes, sha256 79ac5be917b71d50571a4f584436a9f6baf6b6e57719d094ed8bd950e9a65780, bundled via vite ?url as dist/assets/wllama-*.wasm and precached with the app shell (a runtime, not model weights)
llm_runtime.worker_integration: the model runs in a dedicated Worker with no tools, no network, page-data-free input (the OCR text only); the weights come from the S3 model cache as a Blob — measured in-app load ~7.5 s (llama.cpp logs: 372.65 MiB CPU model buffer, n_ctx 2048, Flash Attention enabled); generation uses JSON-schema CONSTRAINED DECODING (wllama compiles CLEANUP_JSON_SCHEMA into a GBNF grammar), temperature 0.2, seed 42, top_p 1, max_tokens 600, enable_thinking false; single-thread WASM (no crossOriginIsolation on this host -> no SharedArrayBuffer), ~2.3 tokens/s
llm_runtime.sampling_note: the app ships the MEASURED probe config (temperature 0.2 / seed 42 — every recorded probe number comes from it). Greedy (temperature 0) was tried during the integration smoke and degenerated identically; recorded in probe-log.md's app-worker section
llm_runtime.degeneration_measurement: under the app's full system prompt, some fixtures generate past the pipeline's fail-closed 240 s cap and fall back (visible flag, deterministic text, guards hold). Final-evidence-run mix: eval 12 applied / 10 fallback over 22 fixtures; uc13 4 applied / 1 fallback (Chromium). This is the designed fail-closed behavior, recorded honestly in llm-eval-chromium.json and e2e.log

pinned_model.status: UNCHANGED from the S3 pin — wllama consumes the pinned GGUF directly; the S4 measurement confirmed the size class, no re-pin

measured_machine_numbers.host: same container as S0-S3 (Debian 13, kernel 6.8.0-147-generic, 16 vCPU, 62 GiB RAM); headless-Linux numbers, single-threaded WASM; real-device behavior is NOT_RUN
